(Japanese: '''ケイコ''' ''Keiko'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP165|Hassle In The Castle]]''. She is a nurse that works at the castle clinic run by [[Dr. Anna]] which uses Pokémon to treat medical issues in humans such as muscle pain and wounds.

Keiko escorted {{Ash}} and {{an|Misty}} to the castle maze's only exit located in the nearby forest, after {{an|Brock}} and Dr. Anna fell into the strange maze below Dr. Anna's clinic.
